OBS-ADDON-AURA-QUERY.note: duration (s) presumably mirrors the server's integer max-duration ms (Trinity wire: Duration) -> exact if so (AL-U-L-02); expirationTime = client receipt time + Remaining -> latency-bound

OBS-COMBATLOG-FILE.api: WoWCombatLog.txt via /combatlog with advanced combat logging
OBS-COMBATLOG-FILE.note: client-written, local clock at receipt; instance-count/source inferred per source GUID from APPLIED without REMOVED; durations only as event-time differences; advanced fields' unit semantics for periodic lines unverified (AL-U-L-05)

OBS-REFRESH-PREDICTION.note: Blizzard's client-side model of a refresh; compare with the server result, never substitute

OBS-SECRECY-QUERY.note: decides whether an addon channel survives in a restricted context for one witness spell

OBS-UI-RECORDING.api: screen recording of Blizzard's own aura frames (they may display secret values)
OBS-UI-RECORDING.note: display rounding and frame rate bound the resolution; last-resort channel

OBS-UNIT-AURA-EVENT.note: added/updated/removed only: no removal cause; isFullUpdate batches hide individual events

duel.note: duel (not a PvPMatch per the enum text; unverified)

group-no-combat.note: open world party, nobody in combat (friendly buffs/HoTs)

solo-no-combat.note: open world, player not in combat (self-cast buffs/HoTs)

quantities.amount: integer amount of a tick or absorb
quantities.caster-stat: caster stat value at a moment
quantities.client-prediction: the client's own predicted refresh result
quantities.event-kind: which lifecycle event happened (applied / refreshed / dose / removed / dispelled / died)
quantities.event-time: time of a tick / removal / refresh
quantities.identity: same aura object across events (instance identity)
quantities.instance-count: number of coexisting instances on one target (per caster)
quantities.max-duration: authored/current maximum duration of the instance
quantities.remaining-duration: remaining duration at a given moment
quantities.same-time-order: server order of two events in the same server update
quantities.secrecy: whether a spell's aura data is secret in restricted contexts
